descFull: Your agents already solved this. deja finds it — it indexes the sessions your coding agents already wrote to disk, months of history from before you installed it, and recalls them automatically at session start across seventeen harnesses. 84.9% hit@1 on LongMemEval-S, no LLM, no embeddings. One zero-dep binary, fully local.
